name: JL_BR_AR_BORDEROS_ALL
description: This is an obsolete table and not in use.

columns.name: BORDERO_ID
columns.description: Identifier for associated bank transfer batch.

columns.name: SELECTION_CONTROL_ID
columns.description: Selection control identifier in bank transfer batch.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the bank account used by the deploying company or by the supplier or supplier site.

columns.name: BORDERO_STATUS
columns.description: Bank transfer remittance batch status. Values are from the lookup JLBR_AR_BORDERO_STATUS.

columns.name: SEQUENTIAL_NUMBER_GENERATION
columns.description: Sequential number for remittance batch generation.

columns.name: BORDERO_TYPE
columns.description: Bank transfer remittance batch type.

columns.name: TOTAL_COUNT
columns.description: Total number of documents in batch.

columns.name: TOTAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total amount of documents in batch.

columns.name: SELECTION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which a bank collection document was selected in a remittance batch.

columns.name: REMITTANCE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which a bank collection document was formatted.

columns.name: REFUSED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which a bank collection document was refused.

columns.name: CANCELLATION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which a bank collection document was canceled.

columns.name: COLLECTION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which a bank collection document was paid.

columns.name: WRITE_OFF_DATE
columns.description: Date on which a bank collection document was written off.

columns.name: DATE_IN_RECEIPT
columns.description: Earliest date for a receipt on any collection document within a specific collection remittance batch.

columns.name: RECEIVED_DATE
columns.description: Date when all collection documents are either refused, received, canceled or written off.

columns.name: OUTPUT_PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the program used to format the bank transfer batch.

columns.name: SELECT_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Account selection control identifier.

columns.name: OUTPUT_FORMAT
columns.description: Output format. Values are from the lookup JLBR_AR_REMITTANCE MEDIA.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: BANK_ACCT_USE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the bank account use.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
